title: Engagement Valet Bonus Rate Card for Ashbury Rewards Members on Guest Folios
content:
Ashbury Rewards members with many elite night credits in the year receive an engagement valet bonus per night on the valet savings posted to Guest Folios.

**Rate.** Engagement valet bonus: a membership with seventy-five (75) or more elite night credits in the current calendar year adds the seventy-five-night valet bonus of $1.00 per night, one with fifty to seventy-four (50 to 74) adds the fifty-night valet bonus of $0.50 per night, and one with fewer adds nothing. The bonus is added to the nightly valet saving, and that per-night figure is then taken for each valet line of the stay.

The elite night credits are those of the current calendar year shown on the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay.

| Elite night credits this calendar year | Valet bonus per night |
|---|---|
| 75 or more | $1.00 |
| 50 to 74 | $0.50 |
| 49 or fewer | None |

## Boundary readings (hypothetical memberships)

| Elite night credits | Bonus per night |
|---|---|
| 49 | None |
| 50 | $0.50 |
| 74 | $0.50 |
| 75 | $1.00 |
| 110 | $1.00 |
